claim: Pax3 is expressed in all dorsal progenitors in the ventricular zone prior to HH stage 14 in chicken embryos.

evidence: The claim is supported by immunohistochemistry data shown in Figure 1A and cited reference to Mansouri and Gruss, 1998.

claim: Dorsal interneurons arise 12-24 hours after the onset of Pax3 expression.

evidence: The claim is based on temporal observations from the experimental data.

claim: Atoh1 is expressed by HH stage 18 in chicken embryos.

evidence: The claim is supported by in situ hybridization data shown in Figure 1G.

claim: dI1s start to be born at the brachial levels at HH stage 18.
source: dI1s start to be born at the brachial levels at the same stage (arrow, Figure 1K).
evidence: The claim is supported by immunohistochemistry data shown in Figure 1K.

claim: Ascl1 expression starts at HH stage 16 in chicken embryos.
source: Ascl1 expression, which defines the dP3-5 domain (Helms et al., 2005), starts at HH stage 16 (Figure 1N)
evidence: The claim is supported by in situ hybridization data shown in Figure 1N and cited reference to Helms et al., 2005.

claim: Ascl1 expression is not robust until HH stage 21 in chicken embryos.

claim: Bmp7 expression starts at approximately HH stage 14 in chicken embryos.
